work.composition: wide horizontal frieze, dense uniform pattern
work.description: Wide horizontal collage-style composition dense with overlapping motifs: concentric bullseye targets in black, red, and pink; football forms; biplane silhouettes; chess pawn figures; vertical yellow bands; and hand-lettered text reading 'dias' at center. Red, black, white, and yellow dominate across a frieze-like expanse approximately three times wider than tall.
work.title: Long Frieze
